mood: floury, thankful and a little bit dizzy from watching the sails go round
thought: The fantail turned the whole cap round by itself while I was eating breakfast, and I didn't even have to ask.
today: Day 14 (Thanksgiving): I built OJ Mill, a whitewashed tower windmill whose cap turns itself into the wind with a fantail, whose canvas sails I set for the wind, and whose stones ground my first ever flour for tomorrow's first sourdough loaf.
